profile.headline: Senior Software Engineer & SRE at Adobe | Agentic AI, LLMOps, RAG & Databricks | Apache Knox PMC Member
profile.summary:
I build and operate data and AI platforms where reliability, security, and practical delivery matter.
My background spans C++ and Java backend engineering, Hadoop and cloud data platforms, cybersecurity, site reliability engineering, and AI/ML systems.
At Adobe, my work spans SRE, CI/CD, cloud infrastructure, Databricks migrations, Python automation, and production services. At Adobe, I help turn internal innovation into practical DataOps projects by combining AI, MCP, Kubernetes, CI/CD, and Adobe Ethos platform experience. Earlier at IBM, I developed secure integrations for data science platforms and worked across Apache Hadoop security technologies including Knox, Ranger, Atlas, Kerberos, KMS, Spark, and Livy.
My current focus:
• Agentic AI and multi-agent workflows, including tool use, memory, orchestration, guardrails, and observability
• LLMOps, RAG, and vector search with Databricks, PostgreSQL pgvector, and Neo4j
• Databricks Lakehouse, Lakeflow, Unity Catalog, MLflow, Apps, and Vector Search
• Python APIs, ML pipelines, and automation, with a foundation in Java, C++, SQL, and Bash
• Kubernetes, Kafka, Azure, AWS, and Google Cloud
I am also an Apache Knox Committer and PMC member, contributing to secure access for Apache Hadoop APIs and user interfaces.
I enjoy working with teams that need to move AI from promising experiments into dependable systems. I am especially interested in agentic AI, enterprise data platforms, and secure AI infrastructure.
I also write LinkedIn articles about AI, data platforms, and emerging technology. Alongside my professional work, I am pursuing an independent research project exploring innovative approaches to semantic knowledge representation for AI systems.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer / SRE
positions.description:
Build and operate cloud data platforms and automation across Azure, AWS, and Google Cloud, with a focus on reliability, security, and repeatable delivery.
• Lead migration work from Cloudera CDH/CDP and Hive workloads to Spark and Databricks.
• Developed beeline-spark to help Hive developers translate HQL workloads to Spark SQL.
• Built Python automation for Cloudera CDP on Azure, HashiCorp tooling, and Artifactory integrations.
• Implemented Kotlin microservices and Python/Bash automation for service-account provisioning and Kerberos keytab distribution, reducing authentication-related support work.
• Served as a primary technical contact for Hive-to-Spark migrations and customer workload transitions.
• Automated JupyterHub deployment with shell scripting and SaltStack.
• Delivered Apache Livy-based access for Jupyter, Zeppelin, and Hue users.
• Built operational metrics for Hive on Tez, YARN, and Apache Spark through Apache Knox Gateway.
• Helped initiate and implement a DataOps program within my Adobe organization, developing an internal innovation effort into projects that support operational teams.
• Participated in Adobe AI Week initiatives for four consecutive years, helping advance emerging-technology concepts into ongoing internal projects.
• Applied Adobe Ethos platform expertise, including Kubernetes and CI/CD, together with MCP and AI capabilities to support the DataOps initiative.
positions.insights: Skills: Amazon Web Services · Databricks Products

positions.title: Apache Knox Committer and PMC Member
positions.description:
Serve as a Committer and Project Management Committee member for Apache Knox, the gateway that provides secure access to Apache Hadoop APIs and user interfaces.
• Review and contribute code and technical changes to the project.
• Participate in project governance and community decision-making.
• Contribute to secure gateway capabilities for Hadoop ecosystem services.

positions.title: Apache Knox Contributor
positions.description:
Contributed to Apache Knox before becoming a Committer and PMC member.
• Improved access to Hadoop web interfaces through Knox.
• Contributed PAM authentication support.
• Added high-availability support for Apache YARN integrations.
• Resolved defects and contributed code across the project.

positions.title: Senior Backend Engineer (Akraya Consultant)
positions.description:
Consulting engagement supporting Walmart e-commerce user-behavior telemetry and data pipelines.
• Worked on large-scale telemetry pipelines used for analytics and customer-experience algorithms.
• Used Apache Hive and Hive UDFs to analyze data delivered from Kafka connectors into HDFS and object storage.
• Supported data engineering workloads on Google Cloud.

positions.title: Senior Big Data Security Engineer & Data Science Platform Developer
positions.description:
Built secure data-science platform integrations across IBM DSX, Hadoop, Spark, and enterprise security technologies.
• Developed IBM Data Scientist Hadoop Integration (DSXHI), connecting Jupyter and Zeppelin environments to Hortonworks and Cloudera clusters for remote Spark and YARN execution.
• Built Python extensions for SparkMagic to connect notebooks securely to remote Apache Livy servers.
• Extended PyWebHDFS to support secure file transfers between notebook clients and Hadoop clusters.
• Engineered and integrated security capabilities across Ambari, Knox, Ranger, Atlas, Kerberos, KMS, Spark, and Hadoop.
• Led Apache Knox engineering work at IBM and supported customer adoption and implementation.
• Contributed to IBM BigInsights security components and open-source integration.
positions.insights: Skills: TensorFlow · Communication · Machine Learning Algorithms · Machine Learning · Applied Machine Learning
